text:
maya: Quick Q — during the canary rebuild this morning CI still had a broad registry token and we accidentally pushed a debug image to prod. Not a full incident but we should tighten scopes. @alex can you confirm which SA is used by the old pipeline?
jess: ugh, I saw that tag. It was `ci-image-maker@infra-project` that still had legacy `registry.*` scope. I rotated the token but didn't change the role.
alex: confirmed, that SA is used by the legacy pipeline (branch: feature/legacy-bake). We never migrated it to the new job runner.
sean: Proposal: create a short-lived scoped token per pipeline with these constraints:
- repo-level write only to `redwood-inference/*` containers
- no org-wide push
- require cosign signature on push for prod tags
- audit logs routed to SEC-AUDIT project
Example IAM-ish policy: ```allow: push
resources: projects/infra/locations/*/repositories/redwood-inference/*
condition: request.time < issuer.expiry```
maya: Also want to add KMS-bound signing for cosign so signatures are backed by our HSM key — lowers risk of token compromise allowing unsigned pushes. Thoughts on key rotation cadence?
alex: KMS-backed cosign sounds good. Rotations every 90 days is reasonable, but let's add an emergency rotation playbook. Who owns it? @jess?
jess: I can own the playbook. Will add step to revoke registry tokens, revoke cosign key bindings, and reissue new keys. We should test key rollover in staging first.
sean: For RBAC change path: 1) Create minimal role `registry.writer` scoped to repos 2) Create per-job short-lived SA tokens 3) Add enforcement in the image promotion job to require cosign sig 4) Add an audit alert: when a push occurs without signature, auto-quarantine tag and notify #eng-oncall.
maya: Can we also add a temporary telemetry metric for unsigned pushes in the next 48h so we measure how many pipelines will break?
alex: yes — I'll add a counter in registry-proxy (metric name `registry.push.unsigned`) and wire to a dashboard.
sre-bot: deploy job succeeded: registry-proxy v2.3.1 -> includes `registry.push.unsigned` metric.
jess: I'll schedule a 30m ops window tomorrow 09:00 UTC to roll the SA roles and cutover. Will post a checklist.
sean: Quick note on incident response: if we detect an unsigned push to a prod tag, run this checklist: `revoke-token <sa>`, `quarantine-tag <tag>`, `trigger-rollback <service>`, `start-postmortem-channel #incident-<id>`.
maya: Perfect. Last ask — can we ensure audit logs include the cosign key id used to sign? That way we can detect if an old key was used.
alex: yes, registry-proxy will log signature metadata (cosign:key_id) in audit payload. I'll include that in the SEC-AUDIT schema.
jess: Awesome. I'll write the playbook and post the link here when ready. Please ping if you see any failing jobs after 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
